Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-estate/

The edge estate as one declarative file: Cloudflare zones, DNS, Worker routes and domains, R2 buckets, tunnels, plus read-only OVH and Hostinger facts; `fw estate plan|apply|check|import` diffs live state against cluster/estate.toml
